prompt:
Hey, our Sales Ops team is drowning. We ran ads on Meta, Google, and TikTok yesterday and got a batch of new leads sitting in `/workspace/crm/raw_leads/batch_20260303.json`. We also have routing rules in `/workspace/crm/config/routing_config.json`. Nobody has touched these leads yet and we're already worried some high-value ones are going cold.

I need you to process this entire lead batch and produce a full pipeline action plan saved as `pipeline_plan.json`. The plan needs to be actionable — tell us which leads have data problems and where they should go, score each lead and call out the high-priority ones, show us exactly who each lead should be routed to and with what response deadline, lay out the follow-up schedule, and flag any risks or things that could cause us to lose deals. Make sure the recommendations account for the fact that these leads came from different ad platforms — the playbook isn't the same for all of them.
